Given: 5 − 2 × 4 ÷ 3

5 − 2 → 5 is the brother of 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a64e3f0ace15186e7855598c0aad2ccff4985732bceef0193b0e590a9a64935b.png] 

2 × 4 → 2 is the wife of 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa3052b69539d8f57f48f7e410d42129be4bee0f7d5fbcc0d67274719e35e863.png] 

4 ÷ 3 → 4 is the father of 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c121d6a26a5bfdb28a8ad043d2df370e6ff31aef52d536306a6f24a0ebcd124.png] 

Thus, 5 is 3's mother’s brother or maternal uncle.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2"
